name: Exp_Super_Trend
summary: This EA trades based on the Super_Trend custom indicator, which uses CCI to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the upper trend signal appears and sell positions when the lower trend signal appears, with optional stop-loss and take-profit. The EA includes money management modes and configurable position open/close switches for both directions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Super_Trend自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用CCI判断趋势方向。当出现上方趋势信号时开多仓，出现下方趋势信号时开空仓，支持止损止盈设置。EA包含多种资金管理模式和买卖方向的开平仓开关配置。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Super_Trend指标的趋势跟踪，该指标内部使用CCI（商品通道指数）判断趋势方向，当CCI突破指定水平时产生信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区2（UpValue）非零且非空值时产生买入信号，同时可作为卖出平仓信号；当缓冲区3（DnValue）非零且非空值时产生卖出信号，同时可作为买入平仓信号。出场条件分两层：一是趋势反转时的信号平仓（UpValue/DnValue触发反向平仓），二是止损止盈的固定点数平仓（StopLoss_=1000, TakeProfit_=2000）。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，MMMode默认为LOT固定手数模式。策略还包含一个额外的历史回溯检查逻辑，当开仓和平仓条件同时启用且当前无平仓信号时，会遍历历史K线查找趋势延续中的平仓触发点，避免在趋势中途遗漏平仓机会。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is trend following based on the Super_Trend indicator, which internally uses CCI (Commodity Channel Index) to determine trend direction, generating signals when CCI crosses a specified level. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 2 (UpValue) is non-zero and non-empty, a buy signal is generated which also serves as a sell close signal; when buffer 3 (DnValue) is non-zero and non-empty, a sell signal is generated which also serves as a buy close signal. Exit conditions operate on two levels: first, signal-based closing on trend reversal (UpValue/DnValue triggering opposite direction closes); second, fixed pip stop-loss and take-profit (StopLoss_=1000, TakeProfit_=2000). Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) with MMMode defaulting to LOT (fixed lot). The strategy also includes an additional historical lookback check: when both open and close conditions are enabled for a direction and no close signal is currently present, it iterates through historical bars to find trend continuation close triggers, preventing missed exit opportunities during ongoing trends.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/扣亏自由保证金/扣亏余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (free margin/balance/margin minus floating loss/balance minus floating loss/fixed lot)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description_en: Bar index for trade signal detection

pros: 支持多种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
买卖方向的开仓和平仓可独立开关控制，策略组合灵活
包含新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免同一K线内重复开仓
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本风险控制
使用自定义指标句柄方式调用，符合MQL5标准架构
pros_en: Supports multiple money management modes, flexible for different risk preferences
Buy and sell open/close switches can be independently controlled for flexible strategy combinations
Includes new bar detection (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated entries within the same bar
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide basic risk control
Uses custom indicator handle approach, conforming to standard MQL5 architecture
cons: 历史K线回溯平仓检查逻辑（123-144行循环）效率低下，在大量历史数据时可能造成性能问题
止损止盈使用固定点数而非ATR动态计算，在不同波动率环境下适应性差
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能导致不合理的入场
CCI周期和Level参数缺乏自适应机制，不同市场状态需要手动调整
未检查指标句柄是否在每次OnTick中有效，仅在OnInit中检查一次
cons_en: The historical bar lookback close-check logic (lines 123-144 loop) is inefficient and may cause performance issues with large history data
Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed pips instead of ATR-based dynamic calculation, poor adaptability across different volatility environments
No spread filter, may lead to unreasonable entries in high-spread conditions
CCI period and Level parameters lack self-adaptation, requiring manual adjustment for different market states
Indicator handle validity is only checked in OnInit, not verified on each OnTick call
improvements: 将历史回溯平仓检查改为基于最近N根K线的有限范围搜索，或缓存已检查位置避免重复遍历
增加ATR动态止损止盈和点差过滤机制，提高策略对不同市场条件的适应性
improvements_en: Change the historical lookback close check to a bounded search over the most recent N bars, or cache the last checked position to avoid repeated traversal
Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit and a spread filter to improve adaptability to different market conditions

risk_points: 历史K线无限回溯循环可能在极端情况下导致长时间阻塞
固定止损止盈在不同品种和波动率环境下可能不合适
缺少持仓检查，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
risk_points_en: Unbounded historical bar lookback loop may cause long blocking in extreme cases
Fixed stop-loss/take-profit may be inappropriate for different instruments and volatility environments
No existing position check before opening, may open duplicate positions in the same direction
